trial.title: Trial
trial.description: The trial mode: one placeholder stage of bats in waves, a fairy that heals, and a golem whose horn breaks. Defeated enemies give experience, and each level gives a stat point to spend. Two elites hold their places until the golem calls them. Placeholder match-ups: the bats are weak to Slash, the elites strong against Pierce and resist every other attack type, the golem weak to Strike and resists every other attack type; its horn has none. The weapons and the seed come from the run setup.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.description: The tutorial mode: three minutes of gentle bats and one weak golem, with no elites, no mid-boss and no Stardust. Placeholder content from the trial stage: the same main character, companion, levels and stars, with the bats weak to Slash and the golem weak to Strike. Every weapon can be switched inside it; the weapon and the seed come from the run setup.
